patch.summary:
Thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Medusa and Square Online share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.

Comparison thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs. Choose Medusa only if your buying job matches “Headless JS commerce — MIT OSS free; Cloud Develop $29, Launch $99 highlighted, Scale $299” rather than Square Online's shape. Choose Square Online only if your buying job matches “Square ecosystem online store — Free $0/mo (higher online processing), Plus $49/location, ” rather than Medusa's shape. Workflow advantage: Medusa leans shared coverage; Square Online leans omnichannel-retail. Trade-off: you gain focus on one product's motion at the cost of the other's adjacent coverage — no universal winner.

Major differences:
- Buyer thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Medusa and Square Online share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.
- Positioning: Medusa is Headless JS commerce — MIT OSS free; Cloud Develop $29, Launch $99 highlighted, Scale $299, Enterprise custom. No GMV tax.; Square Online is Square ecosystem online store — Free $0/mo (higher online processing), Plus $49/location, Premium $149/location; 30-day trials on paid tiers.
- Company-size focus: Medusa (small-business, mid-market, enterprise) vs Square Online (solo, micro, small-business).
- Workflow coverage skew: Medusa-leaning — vs Square Online-leaning omnichannel-retail.
- Researched limits: Medusa — Headless means you still build or buy the storefront UX; Square Online — Best fit inside Square POS ecosystem — weaker as standalone SaaS platform vs Shopify.

Limitations — Medusa: Headless means you still build or buy the storefront UX; Not a WordPress-native plugin path (see WooCommerce); Square Online: Best fit inside Square POS ecosystem — weaker as standalone SaaS platform vs Shopify; Free tier online processing spread (3.3% + 30¢) can exceed paid-tier savings at volume.

Poor-fit cases: Medusa is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Headless means you still build or buy the storefront UX · Square Online is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Best fit inside Square POS ecosystem — weaker as standalone SaaS platform vs Shopify · Avoid Medusa if you actually need Square Online's motion (Square ecosystem online store — Free $0/mo (higher online processing), Plus $49/)

Neither product has a completed hands-on product test on SoftwareGlimpse — this comparison is research/data-based only.
